metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Perry Shortcut
records.biography_en: Perry Shortcut booked a place with The Scenic Miscalculation. I can see a shortcut. The incident report lists folded trail map and giant compass as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I can see a shortcut.

records.name: Mara Chalkstorm
records.biography_en: Mara Chalkstorm booked a place with The Scenic Miscalculation. My chalk is getting impatient. The incident report lists bulging chalk pouch and thick carabiner as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: My chalk is getting impatient.

records.name: Len Lastledge
records.biography_en: Len Lastledge booked a place with The Scenic Miscalculation. Is there a summit without an edge? The incident report lists two collapsed trekking poles held tightly as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Is there a summit without an edge?

records.name: Nell Rockselfie
records.biography_en: Nell Rockselfie booked a place with The Scenic Miscalculation. Hang on. The mountain blinked. The incident report lists chunky compact camera clipped to a fat rope coil as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Hang on. The mountain blinked.

records.name: Hugo Snackbelay
records.biography_en: Hugo Snackbelay booked a place with The Scenic Miscalculation. I brought the emergency snack. The incident report lists rope loop and half-unwrapped granola bar as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I brought the emergency snack.

records.name: Bram Blister
records.biography_en: Bram Blister booked a place with The Scenic Miscalculation. The boot was comfortable in the shop. The incident report lists one tiny hiking boot held by its laces as a prop, bare ink base as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: The boot was comfortable in the shop.
